name: nfs-demo
//: Do NOT add @angular/* here. This app installs into its own node_modules (D014), so declaring the framework produces a SECOND physical copy of it, and the application builder resolves @angular/ssr from the WORKSPACE ROOT when it injects the server manifests -- the SSR build then mixes two @angular/core instances and dies in route extraction with NG0201 'No provider found for InjectionToken PlatformDestroyListeners. Source: Platform: core'. Angular must resolve upward to the monorepo root, which is where the builder itself comes from. D014/D015 are about ngx-foundation-sites, which is still installed here as a real registry tarball and still gated by scripts/verify-registry-consumption.mjs. The three packages below are safe to duplicate because none of them carries DI identity: express hosts server.ts, foundation-sites is what the library's public Sass @imports, and ngx-foundation-sites is the subject of the proof.
